name: kiln
description: A portable content doctrine for search and AI answer engines. Gates outrank the writer: a draft either passes the pre-publication checks or is rejected.

gsc_credentials.title: Google Search Console service account key
gsc_credentials.description: Path to the service account JSON with read access to the Search Console property. A path, not the file contents: the credential store is shared with OAuth tokens and caps at roughly 2 KB, which a Google service account key exceeds.

dataforseo_login.title: DataForSEO login
dataforseo_login.description: Account login for SERP, Labs and Trends calls.

dataforseo_password.title: DataForSEO password
dataforseo_password.description: Account password. Stored in the OS credential store.

serper_api_key.title: Serper API key
serper_api_key.description: Optional. Used for interactive one-off SERP lookups where DataForSEO queue latency is unacceptable.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API key
firecrawl_api_key.description: Optional. Second rung of the fetch ladder, after Jina Reader.
